title: Welcome to K&D 101
subtitle: Your 101st Tour companion
steps: Open the live app using Xavier’s link. Travelers do not need a TD login.
Use the four tabs at the bottom. Switching tabs returns you to the top.
Keep an internet connection for the latest announcements and schedule changes.

title: Install on iPhone
subtitle: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
steps: Open the app link in Safari. If email opens it in another browser, copy the link and paste it into Safari.
Tap Share (or Page Menu, then Share). Scroll to Add to Home Screen; use Edit Actions if it is missing.
Keep K&D 101 as the name. Leave Open as Web App on if shown, then tap Add. See the separate iPhone video for all 14 steps.

title: Install on Android
subtitle: Chrome → menu → Install
steps: Open the app link in Chrome, rather than inside an email preview. Copy and paste the link if needed.
Open the three-dot menu. Depending on Chrome, choose Install and create shortcut → Install, Install app, or Add to Home screen.
Confirm installation, then find K&D 101 on your Home Screen or in your app list. See the separate Android video for all 14 steps.

title: Begin each day on Home
subtitle: Full schedule and Xavier’s announcements
panel: Day arrows • title • date and time
steps: On Home, use the small arrows beside the day number to browse previous and next days. The title, date and complete schedule follow your selection.
Xavier’s announcement also follows the selected day. On the day page, his panel stays visible and tells you if he has not posted yet.
Use Swap Today’s Journey and announcements to choose the Home panel order, then open the selected journey day with the button at the bottom.

title: Calendar and day pictures
subtitle: Journey → banner, dates and route map
steps: Open Journey to see the original banner and the combined Journey Calendar for September and October.
Choose a date or one of the 14 day cards. Use the arrows to move between days, or All 14 days to return.
The illustrated route map is at the bottom of Journey, below all the day cards.

title: Read and save a journey day
subtitle: Day number, date and local time
panel: Day number above the date • local time
steps: Each journey day shows only Xavier’s announcement for that selected day, above its schedule. If he has not posted, the panel says so.
At the bottom, Save this day as a photo makes a screenshot-style image with Xavier’s announcement, current schedule, applicable internal flight and tonight’s stay. Share it or save the PNG.
Download this day as PDF is also at the bottom. Refresh the app before saving to include Xavier’s latest changes.

title: Hotels come before flights
subtitle: Hotels + Flights
steps: Open Hotels + Flights. Each day’s Tonight’s Stay links to its hotel card; spa and restaurant menus and stay guides are linked beneath it when available.
Tap the hotel name on any journey day to open that hotel. Its available stay guides, spa menus and restaurant menus appear directly beneath the hotel link.
Continue below all the hotel cards to see the internal flights.

title: Spa and restaurant menus
subtitle: Expand the menu section at your hotel
steps: At Plataran Komodo, expand Spa menus for Padma Spa or Restaurant menus for Xanadu.
At Four Seasons Jimbaran, expand Spa menus for the Healing Village menu and supplied 2025 tariff. Confirm current 2026 prices.
Open a menu to read its pages or download its PDF. Use Back to hotels in the viewer; every menu PDF page also has a Back to App link.

title: Read your internal flights
subtitle: Route first, flight and time below
steps: On Day 4, Singapore to Yogyakarta is Scoot TR248 at 8:05 AM.
On Day 10, Bali to Labuan Bajo is Batik Air ID 6331 at 11:45 AM.
Flight duration appears when available. Check the latest app and Xavier’s instructions for meeting and airport transfer times.

title: Welcome letter and guides
subtitle: Info → Trip Information
steps: The welcome letter is first on Info. Tap its heading to expand it.
Open the destination guides, dining recommendations and useful contacts as needed.
The original Tauck itinerary is at the bottom of Info. Its viewer includes a return link to the app.

title: Meet your fellow travelers
subtitle: Info → The Guest List
steps: Browse the guest names and hometowns. Guest photos appear when Xavier adds them.
Expand A little about me under your own name and write a short introduction.
Tap Send to Xavier. Your introduction becomes visible to others after Xavier approves it.

title: WhatsApp and shared photos
subtitle: Stay connected during the journey
steps: On Xavier’s card, tap Join Kingdoms and Dragons 101 WhatsApp Group to open the current invitation.
For trip photographs, tap Shared Tour Album to open PhotoCircle. Follow PhotoCircle’s join and upload prompts.
These links open another app or browser page. Return to K&D 101 to continue reading the journey.

title: A little learning and fun
subtitle: At the bottom of each journey day
steps: Try the day’s four trivia questions and review the feedback.
Open Local Language Lesson for greetings and useful local vocabulary.
Read the English-friendly pronunciation aloud. The lesson follows the destination for that day.

title: Take the travelbook with you
subtitle: Open the interactive journey PDF
steps: Use the travelbook link to open the interactive PDF. Tap its contents to jump to a day or section.
Use BACK TO APP to return. Menu and tour document viewers also include return navigation.
A downloaded copy is a snapshot. Reopen or download again after changes to get the current version.

title: Xavier’s one-time sign-in
subtitle: For the Tour Director only
steps: Xavier taps TD Login on his contact card and enters his existing TD password. Guests do not need this login.
One session enables private controls across the app, including announcements, day timelines and guest profiles.
Use Sign out on Xavier’s card when finished on a shared device.

title: Xavier’s editing controls
subtitle: Use the control beside the content
steps: After sign-in, use XAVIER: EDIT NOTE to update the announcement for the day. Save the finished message.
Open the journey date that needs a change and use its timeline editing control. Save and review that date’s updated schedule.
In the guest list, add or replace a guest photo and review submitted introductions. Reopen the travelbook after saved updates.

title: Help, downloads and playback
subtitle: Info → Help & Video Tutorial
steps: Open Help & Video Tutorial on Info to read this updated booklet or watch the animated walkthrough of the current app.
Choose the separate iPhone or Android installation video for detailed Home Screen setup. Videos can also be downloaded.
Pause or move the progress bar to review a step. The in-app speed selector offers 0.5× through 2×. Downloaded-video speed options depend on your player.
